home.headline:
Built because I needed it.

Take it if you need it too.
home.lead: I build them alone and I fix them alone. Office tools, small games, odd utilities. Everything here is free right now, and if you report a bug I usually ship a fix within a few days.

about.lead1: One person does the planning, the building and the releasing. It makes me slow, but when you ask something the person who made it answers.
about.lead2: I wasn't trying to build anything grand. I fixed the things that annoyed me every day and they piled up. Tidying folders was tedious, so I made a file organizer. I hated logging my commute by hand, so I made a web app.
about.lead3: Everything is free right now. Even if paid products show up later, what is already here stays free.

changelog.lead: I write down what I fixed and what I haven't fixed yet.

legal.point3: No marketing email, and nothing is passed to third parties.
legal.point4: Everything here is free. No payment details are collected.
legal.authoritative: The Korean version governs. Other languages are provided for convenience.
